svg.title: Device routing as a decision
svg.desc: At startup OVAT checks the devices. CPU only: everything on the CPU. CPU and GPU: the LLM on the GPU, embeddings and whisper on the CPU. CPU, GPU and NPU: the LLM on the GPU, embeddings on the NPU, whisper on the CPU. Serving an LLM on the NPU needs an int4-cw-ov export, a capped prompt, no batching or beam search, and ignores KV cache settings.
